rules.statement: A prohibition against alienation of property during the lifetime of a beneficiary in a will is valid if it is intended to benefit the children or family, and such prohibition cannot be overridden by court authority.
rules.supporting_quote: "The failure to impose a penalty does not affect a prohibition made in a will such as this where the clear intention is to benefit the children (Sande-Webber's translation Ch. IV. section 3, p. 206)."
